weather.headline: Market Choppy Amid Heightened Cross-Asset Fragility
weather.summary: The market is in a choppy regime, with the S&P 500 down 2.58% today despite a drop in the VIX proxy. While the macro/credit signals are neutral, the high fragility reading indicates elevated cross-asset correlation and risk-off conditions. With the entropy shift flagging a sustained regime shift, the portfolio remained in cash (87.1%) given the uncertain risk outlook.
